stem: Which of the following was an argument made against slavery in the Thirteen Colonies?

options.label: F
options.text: Manufacturers argued that slavery discouraged the development of industry.

options.label: G
options.text: Farmers argued that using slave labor was expensive and inefficient.

options.label: H
options.text: Quakers argued that slavery violated Christian principles.

options.label: J
options.text: Puritans argued that the slave trade encouraged materialism.
